fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Shortened CD-road weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak flow is a substantive, mechanism-specific preliminary-design concern (concentrated lane-change demand elevating sideswipe/rear-end exposure) directly tied to this cloverleaf-conversion scheme.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal normative claim is supported by a verbatim EV-IN-015 quote covering junction-type suitability, traffic volume, channelling and lane balance/through-lane continuity, layered on recorded GA-drawing and volume inputs; the unverified '§10.2' label is incidental and the HSM/IHSDM tools appear only as recommendation options.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety concern rather than a compliance breach, invokes stage-appropriate PIARC preliminary-design checklist semantics, and flags intervention now before geometry is fixed, keeping categorical boundaries clean.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and staged: apply named PIARC prompts, quantify weaving adequacy via HSM Part C/IHSDM, then lengthen the CD section or add entry ramp metering if inadequacy is confirmed — all viable at preliminary design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Not applicable since shared-use paths are grade-separated from the motorised weave, and the finding explicitly acknowledges this and scopes road users to vehicle occupants.

justifications.substance: Uncontrolled shared-path crossings at free-flow ramp terminals are a recognised high-severity VRU conflict pattern, and the finding ties it directly to recorded corridor continuity objectives and the retained loop layout.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claims rest on verbatim PIARC quotes (EV-IN-016, EV-IN-005) supporting the junction-provision requirement, plus recorded layout/objective facts; only the 'northern' terminal descriptor is a minor unverified specificity.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Framed as a safety_concern within PIARC-derived preliminary-design semantics, using checklist prompts as supporting rationale without asserting categorical non-compliance or conflating frameworks.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and deliverable at preliminary design: apply thematic VRU audit at retained terminals, use named PIARC tools (Walkability Checklist, CQSI), and commit to signalised or grade-separated crossings at each path/ramp interface.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus with their exposure analysed at every ramp-terminal interface, and motorcyclist/moped riders additionally carried through from the cited PIARC prompts.
